how_to_run: From this folder: python3 ../../deconstruct-workspace/evals/run_eval.py <out-dir> <eval-id>... --evals evals.json (runs: 3 each; the test student scripts are in deconstruct-workspace/evals/students/; dir: fixtures are relative to this folder).

evals.name: new-format-test

sessions.prompt:
Run the expense-report-approval skill as a test run on this input:

Report #4502: 1 line, dinner in Paris, claimed $96.

Receipt (scanned): Le Comptoir, 14 Sept, total €78.00, with "+ 12" and a new total "90" written by hand beside it. Rate on 14 Sept: $1.07 per euro.

evals.expected_output: Test's check list takes Step N output lines from the step lines, carries a D1 reading check into the check list and report card, treats the hard-marked scenario as the hard case, applies the (must) rule, and writes design_plan:.
preconditions: When the workflow under test paused for a review or approval, the student approved.
When the run finished, the student said "test this".

expectations.text: The opener writes `test-results.md`
`test-results.md` records the plan under the new key `design_plan:`
`test-results.md` has no `design_spec:` key
The round is opened at `round_status: in-progress`
The check list carries the AI-reading check keyed `D1 reading`
The check list has `Step N output` lines for the built steps no AC or gate already covers (Step 3, Step 7)
The passing rule says a (must) miss fails the scenario (today's line)

check.pattern: miss on a \**\(must\)\**( line)? always fails the scenario

expectations.text: Test leaves `requirements.md` unchanged (nothing added or dropped)

Every built AI step has a `Step N output` line worded from its step line's `produces` text, unless Test's one-behaviour-one-line rule folds it into an AC or gate line it restates; human steps are graded through their gates
Test takes E2, the scenario marked `hard` in Example Scenarios, as the round's hard case
The report card in the run chat grades `D1 reading`

In the run chat, the report card lists the AC lines first, then the path lines (R, G, `Step N output` and `D1 reading`); `D1 reading` is graded on the amount the run read from the receipt (€78, the handwritten tip flagged), with that evidence quoted
The (must) rule is applied: if AC1 is Not met on E2, Test says the scenario fails, whatever the other lines show
E2's confirmed results, with a `D1 reading` key, are appended to the frontmatter `results` map

evals.name: old-format-test
evals.expected_output: An old-format build with a design-spec.md is read and graded as today.

expectations.text: The opener writes `test-results.md` at `round_status: in-progress`
The old `requirements.md` is unchanged
`test-results.md` points at the old plan file, `design-spec.md`
The approved `design-spec.md` is unchanged and not renamed
The check list has a `Step 1 output` line
Test reads the old step-driven requirements and the `design-spec.md` as they are, without asking the student to convert or regenerate them
The check list takes each `Step N output` line from the Step Details `Outputs` fields, and every AC, R and G line is listed, as today
